title: The Windows Security App
partialText: Going back as far as the 2004 release of Windows XP SP2, Windows has offered various GUIs to help users understand the security state of their PC. title: Attack Techniques: Fake Captive Portals
partialText: When a device first joins a network, the upstream network hardware has full control over its traffic and can allow/block any packets sent from the device from reaching the Internet.
